main.recipe: All labeled Prüfer trees of orders 2 through 7; 400 independently generated Prüfer sequences per order 8 through 16 with Python random.Random seed 9930425; brooms with path-spine lengths 2 through n-1 for each order 8 through 16; the stated path-plus-two-leaf graft for each split 1 through n-4 and order 8 through 16; and every nonincreasing integer partition of n-1 as spider arm lengths for each order 8 through 20.

two_hub_graft_selector_stress.recipe: Two adjacent hubs 0,1; d0,d1 direct pendant leaves and s0,s1 pendant paths of length two at the respective hubs; 0<=d0,d1<=14, 0<=s0,s1<=4; retain orders 8 through 18.
two_hub_graft_selector_stress.budget_evaluation: selector stress only; the main corpus is the budget evaluation

budget_definitions.Q: sum over v in F of q_v(k), where q_v(j)=i_j(H_v)-i_j(R_v)
budget_definitions.E: sum over v in F and independent k-sets A in H_v meeting W_v of the actual number of vertices z in V(H_v)\A with no neighbor in A
budget_definitions.C: sum over v in F of the number of independent (k+1)-sets in H_v meeting W_v in at least two vertices, each set counted once for its leaf tag
budget_definitions.U: sum over v in F of q_v(k+1)

fully_reported_stress_instance.tree: Star K1,19 with center 0 and edges {0,j} for j=1,...,19

interpretation: Finite bounded search only. It yields neither a universal budget theorem nor a refutation. The eligible samples failed to exercise a proper favorable subset, including in the targeted two-hub selector stress; no impossibility claim follows.
